about_the_game:
The gentle backdrop of the game sets the stage for an uplifting adventure, but the heart of the experience lies in the puzzles themselves. With every stop along the way, you’ll step into vibrant new settings and take on a fresh challenge that keeps your mind sharp and your curiosity engaged.

On the sunny terrace of an animal shelter, Violet and Paul enjoy a quiet moment with their loyal pup, Coop. But when a lively group of new pets arrive — from playful pugs to fluffy chinchillas — their journey begins. Traveling from bustling city apartments to peaceful country ranches, they help each animal settle into its perfect home, creating unforgettable moments where pets and people meet for the very first time.

Each scene offers something new: a carefully designed hidden object puzzle, a clever mini-game, or a whimsical surprise that rewards both attention and logic. No matter if you’re searching for cleverly concealed items or piecing together tricky challenges, the variety keeps every moment fresh!

Featuring:

🔎 Embark on a sunny summer journey full of heartwarming stories and playful surprises!

🔎 Help adorable pets find their forever homes, each with unique challenges to solve

🔎 Dozens of tricky puzzles and brain teasers to keep you engaged

🔎 Explore charming locations: city streets, ranches, gardens, and cozy living rooms

🔎 Discover hidden collectibles and fun mini-games along the way

🔎 Unlock in-game achievements to celebrate your progress

Step into a world where every puzzle brings joy, every home finds a new friend, and every solved challenge leaves you smiling.
